{{Quote|Thank you for meeting with me, Prime Minister Almec.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] greets [[Almec/Legends|Almec]], Prime Minister of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]|<ref name="The Mandalore Plot">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref>}}
'''Prime Minister''' was the title of the head of government for several planetary systems:
*[[Prime Minister (Aguarl III)]]: [[Yenley|Venldy]]
*[[Prime Minister (Bakura)]]: [[Deredith Arden]], [[Molierre Cundertol]], [[Yeorg Captison]], [[Gaeriel Captison]] and [[Deputy Prime Minister]] [[Blaine Harris]]
*[[Prime Minister (Commenor)]]: [[Fyor Rodan]]
*[[Prime Minister (Delaya)]]: [[Gresh Manaa]]
*[[Prime Minister (Demigue)]]
*[[Prime Minister (Kamino)]]: [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]]
*[[Prime Minister (Mandalore)]]: [[Almec/Legends|Almec]], [[Armatan/Legends|Armatan]], [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]]
*[[Prime Minister (Samaria)]]: [[Aaren Larker]], [[Bog Divinian]]
*[[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister (Talus)]]: [[Hagrin Zeed]]
*[[Prime Minister (Tapani Federation)]]
*[[Prime Minister (Vorzyd V)]]: [[Kalasaad Woztu]]
*[[Prime Minister (Zygerria)]]: [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]]
*[[Five World Prime Minister]]: [[Aidel Saxan]]
